[element-notes-group]
=== `<notes-group>` Notes Group

Container for a headed (titled) group of normative or non-normative notes and examples within the narrative body, front matter, or back matter of a standard or adoption.

#### Usage/Remarks
The <<element-notes-group,`<notes-group>`>> element holds one or more normative or non-normative notes (or normative and non-normative examples) as well as a title describing the grouping. The element may be used wherever a headed group of notes is needed in the text of the standard, inside the body and inside many other text structures such as sections.

#### Related Elements

This Tag Set contains several elements that are notes or may be used to group notes: <<element-normative-note,`<normative-note>`>> A note with normative content that can be part of the narrative text or inside one of the notes grouping elements in the body text, front matter, or back matter of a standard or adoption. <<element-non-normative-note,`<non-normative-note>`>> A note with non-normative content that can be part of the narrative text or inside one of the notes grouping elements in the body text, front matter, or back matter of a standard or adoption. <<element-notes,`<notes>`>> A section containing notes that may appear in the front or back matter of a standard or adoption. <<element-notes-group,`<notes-group>`>> A headed (titled) group of normative or non-normative notes and examples within the narrative body of a standard or adoption. <<element-meta-note,`<meta-note>`>> A note within the metadata of a standards or adoption document, as opposed to the other note types that occur within the front matter, body, or back matter of a document.

The following, in order: <<element-editing-instruction,`<editing-instruction>`>> <<element-editing-instruction,Editing Instruction>>, zero or more <<element-label,`<label>`>> <<element-label,Label of a Figure, Reference, Etc.>>, zero or one <<element-title,`<title>`>> <<element-title,Title>> <<element-editing-instruction,`<editing-instruction>`>> <<element-editing-instruction,Editing Instruction>>, zero or more Any combination of: <<element-p,`<p>`>> <<element-p,Paragraph>> <<element-non-normative-note,`<non-normative-note>`>> <<element-non-normative-note,Non-Normative-Note>> <<element-non-normative-example,`<non-normative-example>`>> <<element-non-normative-example,Non-Normative-Example>> <<element-normative-note,`<normative-note>`>> <<element-normative-note,Normative-Note>> <<element-normative-example,`<normative-example>`>> <<element-normative-example,Normative-Example>>

##### Titled group of normative and non-normative notes
[source,xml]
....
...
<notes-group>
 <title>...</title>
 <normative-note id="N1">
  <label>1</label>
  <p>A minimum slope of ...</p>
 </normative-note>
 <normative-note id="N2">
  <label>2</label>
  <p>A maximum slope of ...</p>
 </normative-note>
 <non-normative-note id="N3">
  <label>3</label>
  <p>It is not necessary to ...</p>
 </non-normative-note>
</notes-group>
...
....
